summary: Canonical CI now reproduces FidelityManager transition-hook reentrancy accounting corruption. On test-adversary head c054488e6539eb853458d329b09442adddbc0310, CI run 31465718761 passes format, lint, Luau analysis, audits and swarm tests, then Pure Luau fails the contract-neutral invariant that callback reentrancy cannot leave negative fidelity counts or a count sum different from registered. The same run also reproduces the three failed-hook temporal atomicity assertions. A cross-entity hook that registers another entity then raises remains internally consistent on current main; this is a guard against source rollback implementations that restore global counts without rolling back callback-created registrations.
